equation_summary: Lightning attention delegates entirely to the simple-GLA op with a STATIC per-head decay log-gate g_gamma[h] = -(8/H)(1 - layer_idx/num_layers)*h (a constant vector over time). The mixer law is S_t = exp(g_gamma[h]) * S_{t-1} + k_t^T v_t, o_t = (q_t*scale) S_t (after-update read). The decay depends only on (layer_idx, num_layers, head index), so it is a fixed head-scalar gate, NOT a data-dependent gate.
gate_scope: head (static per-head scalar decay, computed externally from layer index)
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM decay schedule is external E[projections/layer-index decay]: g_gamma is built from layer_idx/num_layers outside the mixer and passed in as a fixed per-head vector
CONFIRM the mixer is U2.A with a per-head decay gate (head scope), via delegation to simple_gla
CORRECT gate scope is head (per-head scalar g_gamma), not channel: g_gamma has shape [H] and multiplies the whole [K,V] state of head h

direction_justification: Lightning attention is exactly U2.A with a static head-scalar decay gate; the only external input is the layer-index decay schedule, so it composes once K2 graph execution exists.
open_questions: The decay is a fixed per-head constant over time; confirm the K2 descriptor admits a time-invariant head gate without forcing a per-token gate tensor.
